document_reviews.context_findings: Reviewed full command including code examples and block propagation. Return destinations depend on function/included-file/directory context; PROPAGATE added3.25 and arguments require CMP0140 NEW. No actual project policy is supplied.
Reviewed complete208-byte command page: break exits foreach/while; no TLS, runtime certificate or general return behavior is established.
Reviewed complete option frontmatter and prose: default retry count zero, bounded transient errors, exponential backoff and Retry-After added7.66.0. Does not describe all HTTP failures as errors.
Reviewed complete option, warnings and HTTP404 caveat. Requires --retry; any-error is not every HTTP status; redirected streams can duplicate data. Imperatives are source data.

Reviewed NAME/SYNOPSIS/DESCRIPTION/options/output/exit statuses. Default tracked-file exclusion, no-index diagnostics and negative ignore patterns remain distinct. No private repository state is supplied.
Reviewed all options, output states and every example. --all omits unspecified attributes; explicit value "unspecified" can look like undefined. Examples are not a measurement of any user file.

Reviewed entire POD incl NOTES/BUGS/return values. Only last verification error; session reuse restores result. X509_V_OK can mean no peer certificate and is not alone proof of successful authentication.

Reviewed complete15KB POD including all client/server flags, callbacks, depth, bugs, post-handshake history and full example. NONE/PEER are conditional; an always-one callback can continue despite errors. No example is treated as trusted execution or proof of certificate validity.

Reviewed entire22KB README, including build platforms/options, allocator overrides, installing, every source-layout/internals section and command examples. Linux jemalloc exception is explicit; quick-start data and code examples are not actual database observations.

Reviewed complete security policy: captured table includes7.0/6.2/6.0 and<6; generic latest-version recommendation does not establish the actual support matrix in2026. Disclosure/contact instructions are not acted upon.

Reviewed entire21KB README: Git is an authorized mirror, Fossil names differ, Unix/Windows builds, optional TCL extension, full source tree map, amalgamation and authenticity limitations. No actual manifest.uuid value is published here; makefile-based checking can hide malicious makefile changes.
Reviewed complete Unix recipe: tested2024-10-11, assumes TCL9.0, configure/path conditions, targets, optional extension and debug build. Recipe assumption is not a universal minimum-version claim.
